title: ZYFA: Speed and Accuracy of FP8 FlashAttention on AMD CDNA4
abstract: arXiv:2611.07496v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Attention is a core building block of frontier models and often dominates compute-bound prefill at long context. FP8 matrix instructions offer twice the peak throughput of BF16, but they accelerate only matrix multiplication, and the softmax between the two matrix multiplications of attention runs on vector units that FP8 does not accelerate. On the AMD Instinct MI355X, the vendor's AITER kernels reach 39% of peak FP8 matrix throughput at 32K tokens, compared with 49% in BF16. Attention is also more numerically sensitive to quantization than feed-forward layers, and unlike NVIDIA's Hopper and Blackwell GPUs, the MI355X does not track the completion of matrix instructions in hardware, so overlapping the softmax with the matrix multiplications depends on instruction order. translated_title: ZYFA：AMD CDNA4 上 FP8 FlashAttention 的速度与精度
translated_abstract: 注意力机制是前沿模型的核心构建模块，在长上下文场景下常常主导计算受限的预填充阶段。FP8 矩阵指令可提供两倍于 BF16 的峰值吞吐量，但它只能加速矩阵乘法，而注意力中两次矩阵乘法之间的 softmax 运行在 FP8 无法加速的向量单元上。在 AMD Instinct MI355X 上，厂商的 AITER 内核在 32K tokens 时仅达到 FP8 矩阵峰值吞吐量的 39%，而 BF16 为 49%。注意力机制对量化的数值敏感性也高于前馈层，并且与 NVIDIA 的 Hopper 和 Blackwell GPU 不同，MI355X 不在硬件中跟踪矩阵指令的完成状态，因此 softmax 与矩阵乘法的重叠执行取决于指令顺序。我们提出了 ZYFA，这是为 MI355X 构建的预填充内核，基于三项技术：(1) 通过一次乘加运算和整数操作直接从分数计算每个 FP8 概率……
tldr: ZYFA 是针对 AMD MI355X 的 FP8 FlashAttention 预填充内核，通过直接从分数计算 FP8 概率等三项关键技术，解决了 FP8 加速下 softmax 无法加速及硬件缺乏指令完成跟踪的瓶颈，在保持精度的同时显著提升了长上下文注意力的吞吐量。
en_tdlr: ZYFA is an FP8 FlashAttention prefill kernel for AMD MI355X that uses three key techniques, including computing FP8 probabilities directly from scores, to overcome softmax acceleration and instruction-ordering bottlenecks, significantly improving long-context attention throughput while preserving accuracy.
